title: wiretap: Add JSON Lines support
description:
Add support for reading newline-delimited JSON log entries. Fetch
timestamps for CloudTrail, GCP audit logs, and Kubernetes audit logs.

notes.body: My ultimate goal is to allow Stratoshark to read raw CloudTrail, GCP audit, and Kubernetes audit logs. This is the first step.
